svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 25 mm, 288 x 138; corners broken 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End skirts: two 12 mm plates 138 x 60, welded under the plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends, flush with them. They keep the piston square in the mold.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push rod: 60 x 60 bar, 238 long, welded square under the plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre with a fillet all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot through the rod, side to side: 37 wide, 200 long; its top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 23 below the plate, its bottom 15 above the rod's foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain drill and file, or mill; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: the rod's bottom face, square and flat; the eject arm's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nose pushes here. Face harden or fit a 6 mm wear pad if wanted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 1 mm clearance each side in the mold; the upper pin sits

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the slot, the upper links either side of the rod (2 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: drops through the mold cavity under its own weight.
